schema_note: Roadmap #49 (2026-08-07): a curated public changelog of material corrections and updates to this site's data -- hand-maintained (not auto-generated from commit history), since raw internal commit messages reference internal tooling/finding codes never meant for public copy. Each entry here is a genuine, dated, already-verified change, rewritten in plain language. Newest first.

entries.summary: Illinois: corrected a renewal-fee page that had wrongly said no fee amount could be confirmed -- it now shows the codified $40/year rate and its source.
Nevada: corrected a quoted phrase on the renewal-fee page to match the cited rule's exact wording.
Colorado: corrected a renewal-fee citation that pointed at a statute section that doesn't exist.

Alaska, Massachusetts, Texas, Alabama, and the District of Columbia: repointed several firm-mobility citation links that had gone dead or pointed at outdated snapshots, to current official or authoritative sources.
Minnesota: briefly downgraded a source-confidence label, then restored it the same day after further checking confirmed both original sources are live.
Iowa: updated citations across all affected pages after the state renumbered its administrative code.
Missouri: replaced a dead CPE source link with the current one.
Kentucky: corrected a renewal deadline that had already elapsed in our data.
Virginia and Minnesota: corrected citation links that pointed at the wrong specific rule.
District of Columbia: corrected which credential types a citation actually covers.
Idaho: corrected the scope of the firm registration deadline.
Kentucky and South Dakota: corrected renewal cycle dates and updated citations to the codified sources.
Refreshed CPA license renewal data across all 55 U.S. jurisdictions.
Extended the license-reinstatement cost and catch-up CPE calculator to cover all 51 states plus DC.
